chat.title: Oracle
chat.description: Pick one of nine shamans. The Astra Rift's cards, the East's pillars and heavens, the North's runes — whoever's grain you choose, they already know your fate.
chat.characterStoryLocked: This story isn't carved yet. It will be soon.

tarot.title: Tarot
tarot.description: Draw a card and glimpse a strand of fate.
tarot.questionPlaceholderOne: e.g. How will this week unfold? (within 100 chars)
tarot.questionPlaceholderThree: e.g. How will this matter flow? (within 100 chars)

saju.title: Pillars
saju.description: The Four Pillars are the stars' configuration at the moment of your birth. The root of every fortune, tarot, and compatibility reading lives here.
saju.noSajuTitle: You haven't read your pillars yet
saju.noSajuDescription: Reading them once deepens every other reading. You only need to compute them once — they stay forever.

compatibility.title: Bond
compatibility.description: A shaman will read how two people's pillars, constellations, zodiac, and personality are tangled together.

personality.title: Persona
personality.description: Twenty questions to learn your nature. Results feed into shaman chat, fortunes, and tarot readings automatically.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDescription: Choose the display language. Fortunes and readings generate in the same language (when supported).
